Escaping *everything* that _matters_

Literal asterisks: *bold* and **strong** and 5 * 3 = 15.

Underscores: snake_case, __dunder__, _leading and trailing_.

Backticks: `inline` and ```fences```.

Brackets: [not a link](http://example.com) and ![not an image](x.png) and [ref][1].

HTML-like: <script>alert(1)</script>, a < b > c, <https://autolink.example>.

Entities in text: &amp; &lt; &#169; stay literal.

# Not a heading

> Not a quote

- Not a list

+ Not a list

1. Not a list

1999. A year, not a list.

===

***

~~~ not a fence ~~~ and ~~not struck~~

Backslashes: C:\Users\name and \*escaped\*.

Pipes | in | text.
